content:
zoe (sales): Signed 12mo enterprise commit. They expect two 15min product launches/month, baseline ~650 concurrent, peak ~2700. Need: reserved GPU recommendation, burst mix (spot/on-demand), prewarm plan, quick pricing sketch, and security answers (KMS + prewarm audit).

cal (solutions): Proposal pattern: reserve for steady 95th, keep a hot prewarm pool per-region for instant spikes, and a larger spot-backed burst pool with burst credits on contract.

mina (infra): Ops note: spot cold-start ~3-6m, on-demand ~1-2m. Prewarm should be cross-AZ, recommend 2 GPUs prewarm per AZ. Consider prewarm-in-VPC for sensitive workloads.

leo (eng-runtime): Measured LlamaX-34B-quant ~550-600 tps/GPU for short completions with good KV cache hits. To meet ~200ms token latency we'll cap batch delay and keep small max-batch sizes.

cal (solutions): Quick calc: peak tokens/s = 2700 * 140 / 20 = 18,900 tps. At 580 tps/GPU -> ~33 GPUs. Add 25% headroom -> ~42 GPUs for peak. Steady 95th (650) -> ~4,550 tps -> ~8 GPUs. Proposed: reserved commit = 8 GPUs, hot prewarm = 8 GPUs (spread AZs), burst pool target = 30-36 GPUs (spot + on-demand).

mina (infra): Autoscale sketch: reserved:8, hot_pool:8, burst_max:36, burst_mix:{spot:0.7,on_demand:0.3}, scale_trigger: token_queue_ms > 100, scale_step:4 GPUs, prewarm_schedule: campaign_start - 10m. Keep prewarm per-AZ to avoid single-AZ risk.

leo (eng-runtime): Fallback rules: when queue latency sustained >120ms, shift new requests to llamaX-13B-quant and enable global throttles. KV cache is ephemeral and encrypted; we can anonymize prefixes for prewarm.

mina (infra): Security: hosted enterprise supports customer-managed KMS (envelope). Prewarm jobs can run in customer VPC for Private deployments. Audit logs available for prewarm runs; cache TTL short and configurable.

ops-bot: Created POC workspace "launch-poc-212500" window 2026-04-20 -> 2026-04-27. Owners: zoe, cal, mina.

zoe (sales): Action items: (1) Leo & Mina run microbench with customer prompts and return per-GPU tps + latency table by Mon EOD. (2) Cal to draft pricing example with reserved monthly + burst-credit proposal. (3) I'll send security questionnaire and request KMS proofs. Thanks everyone :rocket:
